source.title: Chaos Space Marines Faction Pack: Version 1.2

data.summary: As your opponent's Shooting phase begins, you may roll a D6. On a 1, D3 **mortal wounds** are dealt to the unit containing this **PSYKER**; on a 2+, that unit's models get a 4+ invulnerable save for the rest of that phase.
